arena: Try the same task several ways and combine the best parts
benchmark-checklist: Check whether a measured speedup is real
code-review: Check a diff against the spec and the repository's standards
create-formal-verification-skill: Model-check a race or invariant, or audit the existing model
create-verification-skill: Give agents a way to drive the app, or audit its existing verification skill
how: Explain how a code path works or where new code belongs
interactive-prototype: Build something I can click to compare designs
interrogate: Have independent reviewers challenge a diff or design
ketchup: Catch me up on this chat and list what needs my decision
p3stack-mode: Turn on routing for this session
poteto-mode: Use poteto's workflow and response style for one task
recall: Reconstruct where I left off across recent chats
source-grounding: Check an implementation choice against the official docs
statechart: Check a state model and draw the paths that break its rules
swarm: Split checks across workers and give me one report
tdd: Fix a bug test-first with a cheap local reproduction
technical-writing: Write or revise a README, RFC or commit message
why: Trace why a design or threshold was chosen
writing-for-agents: Write or edit instructions an agent will follow
